title: An open G shape
summary: Spread the notes across six strings.

steps.title: An open G shape
steps.body:
G is the short written name for G major: G, B and D. Use fret 3 on string 6, fret 2 on string 5, open strings 4, 3 and 2, and fret 3 on string 1.

**Why it matters:** A six-string sound can still be a triad. Read each position carefully instead of assuming every string is open.

steps.title: Read and hear the notes
steps.body: The low G and high G frame the sound. Open D, G and B in the middle supply the remaining names. This is one common G shape; the same three names elsewhere also count.

items.prompt: Play G, B, D, G, B, G together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Make it familiar
steps.body: Build only G, B and D first. Then add the repeated higher notes from the diagram. Keep your hand relaxed and stop if the stretch hurts.

items.prompt: Play G, B, D, G, B, G together. Use any positions for these notes.
